summary.en: The story takes place several years ago at the Metropolitan Police Department Police Academy. One night, Rei Furuya and Jinpei Matsuda are having a duel. They punch each other at the yard. Matsuda hates Amuro, who "really wants to become a police officer". That night, Hiromitsu Morofushi has a nightmare about his parents' death when he was a child. He is later awoken by a sudden knock on the door, finding an injured Rei, who is asking for some band-aids. The next day, all students gather at the yard. Kenji Hagiwara, Hiromitsu Morofushi, Rei Furuya, Jinpei Matsuda, and Wataru Date are in the same class. Their instructor is Hachizo Onizuka. When Onizuka asks why Rei and Jinpei are injured, Date reasoned that they are too excited when they tried to catch some cockroaches. As a self punishment, Date instructs the class to run an extra lap. Onizuka can't manage to talk more with them as they start running. Another instructor comments that Onizuka has taken five troublesome students. Rei who always getting into fights with other students, Hiromitsu who is traumatized by his parents' death, Date who can't let go of his father retirement from the police force, Kenji who has good communication skill but only uses them to attract women, and Matsuda who has outrageous behaviour and lack of cooperativeness.
